items.name: Oil
items.describe: Generally used as a lubricant, leak-proofing oil, anti-rust, a shock absorber etc

items.name: Oil Drum
items.describe: An empty plastic oil drum that can be used to hold fuel.

items.name: Propane Tank
items.describe: Propane is an extremely explosive gas often used in welding.

items.name: Fuel Tank
items.describe: The metal fuel barrel can be used to hold flammable liquid.

items.name: Kerosene Lamp
items.describe: An old-fashioned oil lamp that can provide a relatively stable light source.

items.name: High Energy Fuel
items.describe: A sealed canister of high energy fuel jelly that's viscous, sticky, and difficult to clean up. Once ignited, it's almost impossible to extinguish, so the utmost care must be taken during storage.

items.name: Nitrocellulose
items.describe: A bundle of Nitrocellulose, an important ingredient in ammo manufacturing. Keep it dry and away from heat.

items.name: Large-Caliber Artillery Gunpowder Pack
items.describe: A pack of gun propellants used for coastal defense. They were supposed to be stored in the Kamona navy's Coastal Defense Force's warehouse, but since it's a fast-burning pyrotechnic, the warriors of the Dark Zone are sure to find new uses for it.

items.name: Impact-resistant Hard Rubber
items.describe: Impact-resistant plastic hard glue that can be used to make shells for electronics.

items.name: Bag of Cement
items.describe: A bag of construction cement from a local company.

items.name: Titanium Alloy Plate
items.describe: A high strength TC4 titanium alloy plate.

items.name: Rubber Pad
items.describe: A thick rubber cushion block.

items.name: Acoustic Panel
items.describe: Effective, high-quality decorative acoustic panels for noise absorption.

items.name: Wood Board
items.describe: Processed boards made of oak. Used in construction.

items.name: Sound-Muffling Cotton
items.describe: Imported sound-muffling cotton that is also waterproof and provides heat insulation.

items.name: Palladium Wire
items.describe: Premium wire made of palladium that boasts high levels of temperature resistance, corrosion resistance, wear resistance, and ductility. It is a highly valuable conductive material.

items.name: Power Cable
items.describe: 220V computer power cord.

items.name: Graphics Card
items.describe: This computer graphics card can run Minesweeper smoothly.

items.name: Broken LCD
items.describe: Many useful microelectronic parts are included.

items.name: Working LCD
items.describe: It can be used as a signal visualization device in a monitoring system.

items.name: PSU
items.describe: This power supply is a universal charger that is compatible with various low-voltage rechargeable batteries and devices.

items.name: SSD
items.describe: Solid State Drive. It is used to store data and has very high read and write performance.

items.name: Chip Processor
items.describe: A special, high-tech device processor. It's sold at a high price.

items.name: RAM
items.describe: A cheap memory stick.

items.name: Floppy Drive
items.describe: A disk drive that can read information written on a floppy disk.

items.name: VGA Display Cable
items.describe: A VGA cable manufactured overseas. Favored by local professionals for its performance stability.

items.name: UPS Unit
items.describe: UPS stands for Uninterruptible Power Supply. Primarily used to ensured continued power supply for electronic equipment in the event of a power failure.

items.name: Studio Monitor
items.describe: A professional studio monitor. In the current environment, its high-quality components are in great demand among mod workshops.

items.name: Vector Processor
items.describe: A computer processor sourced from overseas. After Kamona completed its initial industrialization, Tevila's microchip industry, which was lagging somewhat, struggled to meet the demands of construction. Some countries across the ocean saw an opportunity. Even though they're technically allies of Colom, it's hard for them to refuse Onotos' gold.

items.name: Battery
items.describe: This battery is commonly seen in various portable devices.

items.name: D-size Battery
items.describe: Large D-type battery. Often used by devices with high power demand

items.name: Car Battery
items.describe: Car battery. Dealers often resell them.

items.name: Solar Panel
items.describe: The core part of a solar power generation system. Its efficiency is reduced on cloudy days.

items.name: Battery-Powered Positive Electrode Module
items.describe: Spurred on by Gungnir—particularly one of its key components, the electromagnetic catapult track—the technology of short-term, high-speed energy storage and discharge devices has undergone significant development. To meet demand, this module boasts an extremely high theoretical capacity, but due to high costs and other risks, it can only be found at a few tower construction sites and related corporate warehouses.

items.name: Electric Drill
items.describe: A scrapped electric drill. The charging interface has been damaged.

items.name: Toolkit
items.describe: The friend of electricians and woodworkers. It is very hard to come by in war-torn areas.

items.name: Hydraulic Rebar Cutter
items.describe: An electro-hydraulic unit; local construction workers use it to cut through rebar.

items.name: Pipe Wrench
items.describe: A pipe wrench for cutting pipes.

items.name: Toolbox
items.describe: A common multipurpose tool kit.

items.name: Blower
items.describe: A small air-blower.

items.name: Flashlight
items.describe: A tungsten flashlight that can be used for both illumination and self-defense when necessary.

items.name: High Power Flashlight
items.describe: It can illuminate the dark corners and the long silent night.

items.name: Hydraulic Wrench
items.describe: A torque wrench made of high strength alloys; can efficiently tighten bolts even in small spaces.

items.name: Safety Hammer
items.describe: Lightweight emergency hammer; the tip is designed to quickly break through hard surfaces.

items.name: Portable Jack
items.describe: A small hydraulic jack; used to lift objects within a limited weight range.

items.name: Pipe Cleaning Kit
items.describe: A pipe cleaning kit for household use. Never suffer a blocked pipe again.

items.name: Oil Bottle
items.describe: A compact oil bottle used in the everyday maintenance of household appliances.

items.name: Glue Gun
items.describe: A household glue gun that can be used to apply glue to the target surface by hand, albeit inefficiently.

items.name: Hydraulic Expander
items.describe: Part of the rescue tool set along with the scissors and expanding pliers, cutter, and support rods. It is used to retract, pull at, and flatten the target object, and is often used in fire and disaster relief situations.

items.name: Blowtorch
items.describe: A small blowtorch powered by a portable fuel canister. It's a handy tool for starting engines on cold winter mornings, searing a ham, or even lighting a cigar.

items.name: Photo Frame
items.describe: An old wooden photo frame that may have once preserved precious memories.

items.name: Game Cartridge
items.describe: A game cartridge.

items.name: Hearing Aid
items.describe: A mini hearing aid; helps the hearing-impaired in daily conversations. Not for use as a tactical earpiece.

items.name: Watch
items.describe: A regular watch made by local artisanal watchmakers. Casual and cost effective, can be a souvenir.

items.name: Bag of Fertilizer
items.describe: Imported fertilizer with a high performance-to-cost ratio. Popular among local farmers.

items.name: Camping Tarp
items.describe: A camping tarp that effectively shields against the rain.

items.name: Film Stock
items.describe: Imported movie film stock that is no longer usable today.

items.name: Handheld Fill Light
items.describe: A handheld light used to provide more illumination in environments where light is lacking.

items.name: Camping Stove
items.describe: A portable stove that can provide a modest flame out of doors. A must-have item for campers.

items.name: Deluxe Tea Set
items.describe: An exquisite set that's best reserved for imported teas such as black tea. To a certain extent, their interest in tea serves as a contrast to the lifestyle of the locals.

items.name: Lute
items.describe: A well-preserved traditional plucked string instrument. It brings joy and comfort to life, even in times of hardship and war.

items.name: Glucose Injection
items.describe: Infusion bags stocked by local hospitals; used to maintain patients' fluids.

items.name: Syringe
items.describe: Disposable syringes in sterile packaging.

items.name: Thermometer
items.describe: A medical device used for taking temperature instantly.

items.name: Medical Sponge
items.describe: A medical consumable commonly used in surgery. It acts as a filler to quickly treat wounds.

items.name: Medical Scissors
items.describe: A pair of surgical scissors.

items.name: Bios.
items.describe: Unknown biological matter from a clinic; very popular on the Market.

items.name: Disinfectant
items.describe: Common disinfectant.

items.name: Automated External Defibrillator
items.describe: A portable medical device that can be used by non-professionals to save patients who are in cardiac arrest.

items.name: Insulin Pump
items.describe: A high-end medical instrument consisting of a pump, a small syringe, and a cannula. Automatically injects micro volumes of insulin over time into the user to mimic the body's production of insulin.

items.name: Metal Heart
items.describe: At its most basic level, a metal heart is really just an extremely durable mini-pump capable of replacing an organic heart. There might not be much demand for heart transplants in the Dark Zone, but people always need a sturdy little pump... even if it is a bit of wasted potential.

items.name: Gold Cheetah Statue
items.describe: A golden cheetah running. Or maybe it's a leopard?

items.name: Commemorative Coin
items.describe: Valuable commemorative coins. It might be a fake.

items.name: Vase
items.describe: A vase that looks very expensive. It records the life of a nobleman.

items.name: Gold Watch
items.describe: An expensive gold watch. The hour hand seems to be faulty.

items.name: Gold Lion Statue
items.describe: A valuable golden lion statue.

items.name: Desk Clock
items.describe: A table clock with extremely exquisite craftsmanship.

items.name: Antique Teapot
items.describe: A rare antique ceramic teapot.

items.name: Silver Badge
items.describe: A silver badge with special meaning.

items.name: Silver Chain
items.describe: A rough silver bracelet.

items.name: Gold Bracelet
items.describe: A crudely-made gold bracelet.

items.name: Porcelain
items.describe: Fragile porcelain. Its value lies in the patterns adorning its surface.

items.name: Gold-rimmed Glasses
items.describe: Gold-rimmed glasses that reflect the wearer's worth.

items.name: Stamp Album
items.describe: A special collection booklet for safe preservation of stamps.

items.name: Record Player
items.describe: Electrical equipment for playing records.

items.name: Pocket Watch
items.describe: An intricately-crafted chain pocket watch with a beautifully-decorated caseback.

items.name: Stamp
items.describe: A voucher for sending mail. It's also a collectible.

items.name: Spur
items.describe: Marsden's son always dreamed about being a cowboy so, for his 12th birthday, Marsden got a blacksmith in the next town to make him a set of spurs. On the day of his son's birthday, Marsden got up early and headed to the blacksmith's. But then, he suddenly heard gunfire as he was returning to the Farm.

items.name: Gold Block
items.describe: Local goldsmiths process this Onotos gold; local rich people see it as a way to preserve their wealth so they stock up on it and store it at home.

items.name: Diamond Ring
items.describe: Expensive diamond ring set with a large diamond.

items.name: Brooch
items.describe: Brooch made by local jewelers. It is expensive but beautiful and very popular in local stores.

items.name: Gold Cube
items.describe: Kamona's most famous goldsmith randomly created this cube while forging gold jewelry. Both goldsmith and cube disappeared from the island. Generations later, local goldsmiths began re-creating this cube in his memory, making this golden cube a popular collector's item in the area.

items.name: Gem Necklace
items.describe: Master goldsmiths set choice gemstones on just the right Onotos gold to create this dazzling necklace.

items.name: Gold Cup
items.describe: This handmade artisanal gold cup was sold for a shocking price at auction; from this point, people began to see the collectible value of Kamona goldware.

items.name: Vintage Typewriter
items.describe: A typewriter from Colom that many large companies purchased in bulk due to its reasonable price and durability. Some local merchants came together to bring in a shipment of these typewriters and later sold them to local companies.

items.name: Plaster Sculpture
items.describe: A practice piece with no name. Passable, but the student clearly put their heart into their work.

items.name: Majestic Sculpture
items.describe: A forged sculpture made of plaster and gold. The exquisite details show that its maker was a master of their craft. According to the locals, the sculpture was once used as a decoration in a Marulos party and was the brightest star of the night.

items.name: Gold Snake
items.describe: A golden serpent coiled tightly around some ore. Grab the wealth that falls into your lap and never let it go!

items.name: Skyhook Synchronized Array Mirror
items.describe: The secondary reflector of the Skyhook Guidance System by Ring of Nibelungen. It entered the black market due to manufacturing defects. This collection of defective products allowed the public to gain a glimpse into Project Gungnir, yet at the same time, scholars of related fields started to express more doubts about the project.

items.name: Sergey 1 Satellite Model
items.describe: A model of the world's first satellite launched by Tevila. Even though the Sergey 1 only remained in orbit for 20 days, it was enough to be labeled a key step in scientific research and a monumental moment in human history.

items.name: Raw Diamond Ore
items.describe: Most would find this unremarkable stone easy to overlook without a certificate from a geologist, not even if it was displayed in a high-quality display cabinet. Though there is never a shortage of collectors willing to pay a high price for raw ores like this.

items.name: Jade Bracelet
items.describe: A jade bracelet made of vibrant, dense, and flawless beads with a superior texture.

items.name: Gold Pen
items.describe: A gilded, standard fountain pen with a faint Oligarch ID etched into its cap. It's likely to have been distributed by an oligarch department, though the reason they have appeared in the Dark Zone remains a mystery to be uncovered.

items.name: Document
items.describe: What looks to be an obsolete file.

items.name: Hardcover
items.describe: Hardcover notebooks from local stationery factories; a hit with wealthy local kids.

items.name: Folder
items.describe: Strange writings and graphs in an unmarked folder. It's in English, but you barely understand any of it. The word "Gungnir" appears multiple times. First found in the farm.

items.name: Gungnir Blueprint Fragments
items.describe: A collection of torn-apart Gungnir blueprint fragments. The contents seem to include sections of an enormous rail, whose design is consistent with the international standard launcher and has not been adapted for any specific country or region.

items.name: Gas Analyzer
items.describe: An analyzer used by scientists to analyze the components of gas.

items.name: Air Tightness Tester
items.describe: Locally produced air-tightness test tools. Affordable, simple and a favorite with engineers.

items.name: Wave Filter
items.describe: A special power filter used in armored vehicles.

items.name: Oscilloscope
items.describe: An instrument that assists users in observing electrical signals.

items.name: Antenna
items.describe: An ordinary antenna for civilian use. Only a few local families have use for it, though.

items.name: Gimbal
items.describe: A balancing apparatus for cameras that stabilizes the frame when in use.

items.name: Light Meter
items.describe: An instrument that measures light intensity and, when conditions are met, is capable of calculating the aperture value for optimal exposure.

items.name: Weapon Parts
items.describe: Parts disassembled from weapons. They can be recycled.

items.name: Cannon Shell
items.describe: High-explosive shell fragment.

items.name: Paracord
items.describe: Parachute cord. It is extremely strong and durable.

items.name: Military Canteen
items.describe: An aluminum military-issue water bottle. Makes it easy to carry clean water.

items.name: Rangefinder Binoculars
items.describe: A telescope with a laser ranging feature.

items.name: Portable Transceiver
items.describe: A handheld, wireless walkie-talkie with an extra-short wavelength.

items.name: Military Radio
items.describe: Old radio stations may still be able to intercept useful information.

items.name: Receiver
items.describe: A signal receiver.

items.name: Signal Jammer
items.describe: An assembled signal jamming device.

items.name: TI Module
items.describe: Components of a thermal imaging system.

items.name: Radio
items.describe: A station that can transmit and receive radio signals; usually found in local signal stations.

items.name: Leveler
items.describe: A tool used to test leveling; handle with care to ensure accurate results.

items.name: Target Positioning Module
items.describe: One of the components of the military laser rangefinder. This is the module for target positioning.

items.name: Laser Pointer Module
items.describe: One of the components of the military laser rangefinder. This is the laser pointer module.

items.name: Game Console
items.describe: It is broken. It was the star product of the holidays.

items.name: DVD
items.describe: It is the latest music player, provided that you can afford the corresponding disc.

items.name: Classic Radio
items.describe: A radio with poor sound quality.

items.name: Lens
items.describe: A lens used in video capture devices and security systems. It's very fragile, so please handle with care.

items.name: Camera
items.describe: A heavy optical device. Its flash is useful for nighttime photography.

items.name: Gold Phone
items.describe: A golden phone that looks very expensive.

items.name: Data Cable
items.describe: An ordinary data cable that can be used to transfer data between computers.

items.name: Video Camera
items.describe: An imported video camera designed for civilian use. While it looks a little old, it works perfectly fine.

items.name: Laptop Computer
items.describe: A new kind of computer that has exploded in popularity overseas. While it is highly portable, it also commands a rather hefty price tag. Only a few wealthy families are likely to buy it.

items.name: Portable Fuel Canister
items.describe: A portable fuel canister developed by Chapman's outdoor department. It's said to be made of safer and more durable materials than other canisters on the market.

items.name: Magnesium Flint
items.describe: A dark metal rod with a black striker. Scraping the magnesium rod produces high-temperature sparks, making it a reliable fire-starting tool for the wilderness—especially useful in wet conditions.

items.name: Arched Corrugated Steel Plate
items.describe: A cut of arched corrugated steel plate, displayed in stores. It's covered in a rust-proof layer, and a numbered tag is affixed to the corner. In Kamona, samples of building materials like this are often harder to come by than the finished products.

items.name: Solar Charger
items.describe: A portable solar charger developed by Chapman. Capable of storing, charging, and supplying power alongside being waterproof for outdoor use.

items.name: Ni-Cd Battery Pack
items.describe: A rechargeable Ni-Cd battery pack. Compared to regular rechargeable batteries, it offers excellent high-current discharge performance and better resistance to overcharging or over-discharging.

items.name: Capacitance Analyzer
items.describe: A handheld capacitance analyzer featuring a small LCD screen on the front. Commonly used to measure capacitor values and detect electrical leakage in circuits.

items.name: Space Lab Toybox
items.describe: The "Space Lab" was a complex toy meant to help educate children about space. Produced by a toy manufacturer in Colom, it was delicately crafted—and extremely expensive. Less than a year after Space Lab was released, consumers discovered the toy came packaged with a small bottle of caustic, highly poisonous rocket propellant, after which it was quickly pulled from shelves by the Toy Association.

items.name: Quantum 2000 Toy Robot
items.describe: A toy robot designed by a well-known toy manufacturer in Colom. It can be programmed using a built-in cassette tape, and its actions recorded with a remote control. The robot also functions as a simple cassette player. Due to its high price, it was discontinued after a limited production run. Years later, its rarity has made it a valuable collector's item.

items.name: Voice of Civilization Gold Record
items.describe: To commemorate humanity's systematic exploration of outer space, Colom's aerospace department commissioned the creation of a gold record, "The Voice of Civilization." Its surface is etched with images of code and other special symbols that represent human civilization. The original record has flown through space on a detector. To memorialize this expedition, a few golden records were created using the exact same process. An aerospace engineer born in Kamona brought one of these back to their homeland, etching the words "Song of Kamona" onto the back of the record as a tribute to their home.

items.name: Northern Stars Amber Drink
items.describe: Northern Stars is an aged, fruit-infused fermented beverage crafted by a long-established Tevilan distillery. Rumor has it that its recipe contains rare local wild berries and distilled alpine spring water, and that it was once reserved only for the high-ranking officials of the Northern Military Region. Each bottle is packed in an exquisite handmade walnut mechanical box. Later, the original distillery was shut down during the war, and both the recipe for Northern Stars and the box's unique craftsmanship were lost forever.

items.name: Toland Access Card
items.describe: An access card issued to R&D personnel in Toland's Zombie Division. This card grants laboratory staff clearance, allowing the holder to access key areas throughout the facility.

items.name: Handheld Tester
items.describe: A handheld medical tester. Precisely extracts a sample and provides the requested results.

items.name: EEG
items.describe: The EEG is an advanced medical device developed by Toland Group's first medical department. It collects data on and monitors brain waves, providing essential, technological data to support medical diagnoses and scientific research. However, rumors have always circulated on the black market that the first medical department conducted illegal experiments on the brains of refugees to perfect this device.

items.name: Blood Glucose Meter Set
items.describe: A blood glucose meter set from Elisir Medicina. The box contains a portable glucose meter, a lancet, and insulin.

items.name: Electronic Stethoscope
items.describe: An electronic stethoscope sold by a subsidiary of Elisir Medicina.

items.name: Infrared Therapy Lamp
items.describe: An infrared therapy lamp manufactured by Elisir Medicina. The green metal lampshade is mounted on an adjustable support rod. Once turned on, it heats the filament, emitting a dark red light and thermal radiation. Formerly a standard fixture in Colom clinics and rehabilitation rooms, it has become a scarce commodity in the Dark Zone, valued for both its warmth and relief from lingering injuries.

items.name: Mutant Heart Sample
items.describe: A mutant heart sample sealed inside a biomass constant-temperature storage container. This valuable mutant sample was acquired by a Sumek Committee zombie rapid response team during a large-scale extermination mission. The sample's structure is well-preserved and highly mutated, making it of immense research value.

items.name: Pheromone Test Kit
items.describe: Rumor has it that shortly after the zombie disaster broke out, Toland rapidly developed a Pheromone Test Kit in secret. By injecting different pheromones, users can influence the behavioral tendencies of mutants within range and also evade mutant attacks for a certain period. It is said that this kit was only issued in small quantities to supervisory personnel and frontline special forces squads.

items.name: Blocker Injector
items.describe: Following the zombie disaster, Toland provided the Committee with a batch of blockers and specialized Blocker Injectors. During the early stages of a mutant virus infection, administering the blocker can stop the virus from spreading and even render it inactive over time.

items.name: Mutated Tissue Mass
items.describe: A mass of mutated tissue shed from a mutant. The cross-section still retains distinct muscle fibers, while the surface exhibits the distinctive mutant crystallization and tarring characteristics.

items.name: Gilded Cage Music Box
items.describe: One of Colom's most venerated watchmakers produced this limited-edition music box to commemorate 100 years in business. Delicately crafted in the form of a gilded cage, this stunning piece was sold out before it even hit the shelves.

items.name: Phaethon's Clock
items.describe: The specter of Sumek still haunts the hearts of some people. Fearing the day they dread so much may come, these fearful folks created this special clock in the name of Phaethon, son of the sun god.

items.name: "Dawn"
items.describe: An oil painting created by one of Tevila's most famous artists after the Sumek comet was discovered.

items.name: Real Matrix
items.describe: "Face the truth or indulge in a fabrication?" To commemorate the classic science-fiction film, the renowned Colom jewelry company has released a limited-edition gemstone collectible.

items.name: Ancient Golden Mask Replica
items.describe: Based on the golden mask of the most famous ruler in the history of the desert, this exquisite 1:1 replica was copied from the museum original. With the enormous amount of gold and gemstones used in its creation and the fact that it was handcrafted by contemporary masters, this modern replica is extremely valuable to collectors.

items.name: Hefra Egg
items.describe: The Hefra Egg, also known as the Tevila Egg, is a precious collectible from a series created by the famous Tevilan jeweler, Paul Auster. The egg is named after the Hefra River, the mother river of Tevila.

items.name: Lyre
items.describe: The lyre is one of the earliest plucked string instruments, often appearing as a symbol of music in the mythology of various nations in the Ocean Alliance. This particular lyre is an expensive custom collector's piece, made by a renowned luxury instrument workshop in Colom for its centennial celebration.

items.name: Heavenly Sphere
items.describe: A precious collectible crafted by professional Eastern artisans. Its design is inspired by an important astronomical instrument from an ancient Eastern kingdom used for observing celestial phenomena. The dragon-shaped base supporting the armillary sphere represents the eight mountain pillars that hold up the sky in Eastern mythology.

items.name: Peacock Fan
items.describe: A handheld fan handcrafted from peacock feathers, gold, and jewels. It was inspired by an ancient kingdom that revered peacocks. Legend has it that they used peacock feather fans as ceremonial regalia exclusively for the monarch, symbolizing royalty and protection.

items.name: Amber Heart of Heaven
items.describe: A large piece of meteorite with a smooth cross-section, small enough that an adult could hold it with both hands. It's entirely deep iron-gray in color and has a large, translucent, yellowish-brown crystal structure embedded in its center, which emits a warm, amber-like luster under light. After this meteorite was purchased at an auction by a wealthy Kamona merchant, it was named the "Amber Heart of Heaven."

items.name: Optoelectronic Hyperspace Model
items.describe: A die-hard fan of Colom's sci-fi movies hired someone to create an optoelectronic model of a famous scene from a renowned sci-fi film about space travel. The model looks like the hyperspace shown in the movie.

items.name: "Destiny" Gold Clay Tablet
items.describe: A massive sintered clay tablet, dark brown and with slightly chipped edges. Its surface is engraved with gold cuneiform and astrological symbols. There's an image of a prophet in the center, flanked by vivid, precise, golden reliefs of Aries and Taurus. Research indicates this tablet resembles the astronomical records of an ancient river valley civilization, making it one of humanity's earliest astronomy documents.

items.name: Star of Kamona Pendant
items.describe: A necklace with several massive aquamarine gems as its centerpieces, accented by a multitude of crushed diamonds. The main gems are a translucent aquamarine hue, almost entirely free of impurities, while the tightly encircled diamonds create a layered halo effect. Legend has it that the aquamarine pieces came from a giant uncut gemstone, named "Mercury," that was unearthed in a Kamona mine and of a quality previously unseen in the region. A wealthy local merchant funded its cutting and polishing and commissioned a renowned jeweler to craft this necklace. Naming it the "Star of Kamona," the merchant intended it to be a symbol of home. However, ever since its creation, every one of its owners has been drawn into conflict and each time it changed hands, it was accompanied by struggle and ruin.

items.name: Double-Neck Lute
items.describe: A rare double-necked lute carved entirely from a single piece of mammoth ivory. The body features intricate relief carvings depicting excerpts from the heroic epic of Ostur III from the era of the Tevilan Empire. This lute was originally a family heirloom of a fallen noble family in southern Tevila. It changed hands several times during the war before it eventually found its way into the Dark Zone. Rumor has it that the noble attempted to flee to Colom with the lute but was detained at a border checkpoint, separating the instrument from its owner. Due to its precious material and intricate craftsmanship, it continues to fetch an extremely high price on the black market.

items.name: Voss' Journal
items.describe: The journal of famed bunker survivalist Voss. Outlined within are instructions for constructing a personal underground shelter, a 180-day survival plan, guides on water filtration, and other tips and tricks for living under extreme conditions. Only a few copies of the journal have been printed, and it has only been distributed among select groups. The work is known for its unique titanium alloy cover.

items.name: Space Boy Comic
items.describe: "Space Boy," a Colom superhero comic book. It tells the tale of an alien with superhuman abilities who joined the Earth Alliance and helped them avert galactic calamities.

items.name: Dried Flower Bookmark
items.describe: A handmade dried-flower bookmark, with carefully selected flowers and leaves meticulously sealed in transparent film. Two names are written in fine ink along the edge: Marta and Valentina. Marta had made this dried-flower bookmark for her friend, and the two had agreed that Valentina would come to pick it up the next day. That evening, however, there was an unusual howling outside the house. Marta set aside the finished bookmark to go see what it was—and never returned. The next day, Valentina also didn't show up as planned, and the bookmark remained right where it was, like an undelivered letter.

items.name: Bundle of Rice Paper
items.describe: A bundle of rice paper. The paper is delicate and flexible, with slightly yellowing edges. Originally from an Eastern country, it made its way into Kamona through trade channels before eventually ending up in the Dark Zone.

items.name: Mutant Evolution Sketch
items.describe: A hand-drawn sketch of a mutant's evolutionary process left behind by a Bay Area resident trapped at Guoyapos Airport. The drawing details the physical changes of the infected at different stages, as well as their complete form upon finally becoming a mutant. In a later investigation, a purge squad found the author of this sketch in front of a mirror in the airport restroom.

items.name: Aerospace Navigator
items.describe: A special navigation device once used in the Tevilan space program. This electromechanical analog computer uses an intricate system of gears, cams, and differentials to help spacecraft determine their position.

items.name: K7-L Cipher Machine
items.describe: A famous cipher designed by the Colom Defense Intelligence Service. By integrating rotor and electronic technologies, its safety and convenience have both been significantly enhanced.

items.name: Three-Axis Gyro Controller Prototype
items.describe: A miniature prototype of a three-axis gyroscope controller for aerospace use. The genuine device was used in Tevila's Blizzard space shuttle. As a prototype for a key component of a groundbreaking spacecraft, it is extremely valuable among elite collectors.

items.name: Handheld Receiver
items.describe: A handheld receiver designed by Universal Communications. Due to its reliability and durability, many Colom soldiers purchase it with their own funds.

items.name: Handheld Salinity Meter
items.describe: A handheld salinity meter developed with investment from Wyllie Co., capable of quickly measuring the salt concentration in a solution.

items.name: Handheld Calculator
items.describe: A handheld calculator made by Chapman. It features a dark body, a monochrome LCD screen, and hard plastic keys for basic scientific calculations.

items.name: Military Tool Kit
items.describe: A military tool kit, full of gear capable of solving a variety of battlefield emergencies.

items.name: T-147 Individual Communication Device
items.describe: A small, portable radio issued by Tevila to its frontline troops. It grants access to FM and AM stations.

items.name: Prototype Calculation Module
items.describe: A calculation module for the TESM-6 prototype computer produced by Svarog's military-industrial complex. It was once a contender for inclusion in Tevila's newest generation of supercomputers, but was beaten out in the final stages by a similar product produced by Omas' military-industrial complex. In the end, the TESM-6 project went bankrupt, and this module found its way onto the black market.

items.name: Capsule TV
items.describe: The Capsule TV is a brand-new smart TV. It's portable, has an HD display, and includes smart interaction features. It was once a major milestone for Global United Comms, part of their entry into the consumer entertainment market, but later on, increasingly fierce competition caused the Capsule TV to be pushed out by newer products. As a result, there aren't many units left, which have made them quite valuable to collectors.

items.name: Personal Digital Assistant
items.describe: A personal digital assistant released by Universal Communications. It boasts solid sales figures in the Ocean Alliance.

items.name: MRID Clamshell Laptop
items.describe: The first clamshell laptop introduced by MRID, and the world's first portable computer of its kind. It features a dark gray magnesium alloy body, with a rugged industrial design bearing the distinct mark of its era. Thanks to its sturdy magnesium alloy casing and solid-state storage technology, this machine was purchased by both the Colom military and the Colom Space Agency right after its launch, and used as onboard equipment for space shuttles executing low Earth orbit missions.

items.name: GU-470 Portable Recorder
items.describe: The GU-470 portable home recorder produced by Universal Communications. Thanks to its comprehensive features and excellent design, it has seen good sales in the global home recorder market.
